rationale: Retain GFL Environmental Services as the canonical North American infrastructure-services platform, establish the legal GES alias and current operating website, and correct the ownership ledger to the current post-HPS structure. Apollo and BC each acquired approximately 28% and GFL retained approximately 44% at the March 1, 2025 closing; HPS's September 3, 2025 equity subscription diluted those interests to approximately 22%, 22% and 34%, respectively, while HPS obtained approximately 22%. Apollo's official announcement explicitly attributes the investment to capital from its Infrastructure and Hybrid Value strategies. GFL's call option is not a signed pending transaction. No later ownership exit was identified through August 8, 2026.

afterImage.name: GFL Environmental Services
afterImage.description: GFL Environmental Services (GES) is a North American environmental-infrastructure services platform providing liquid-waste management, soil remediation, used-oil re-refining, field and industrial services, waste processing and recycling, and specialized transportation. The company serves more than 50,000 customers through more than 260 locations and a specialized fleet of more than 5,500 assets. GES became an independent joint-venture platform effective March 1, 2025 in a transaction valued at C$8.0 billion. Following HPS Investment Partners' September 3, 2025 equity subscription, GFL Environmental Inc. retained approximately 34%, while Apollo-managed funds, BC-managed funds and HPS-managed funds each held approximately 22%. Apollo stated that its investment included capital from its Infrastructure and Hybrid Value strategies.
